text:
maria: quick spike: spun up v3-int4-lite on the long-doc route (2% traffic). saw p95 down ~110ms, cost ~-18%, but long-doc MRR down ~1.7% after 2h smoke. proposing fractional warmstart 1% -> 2% -> 5% with stability checks. cc @dain @raj

dain: paste the numbers and which slice exactly? what's your fallback window?

maria: smoke snapshot: p50 -40ms, p95 -110ms, cost/tokens -18%, long-doc (>3k tokens) MRR -1.7% (CI borderline), hallucination +0.0%. 2h smoke at 2% traffic.

sophia: those wins are compelling but the MRR is close to our tolerance. propose fallback if (MRR_drop >= 1.5% over 2h AND p95_latency_increase >= 150ms) OR hallucination_increase >= 0.5%. add cooldown 60m after rollback. :thumbsup:

raj: to avoid oscillation require two consecutive stable windows (2h each) before stepping up. smooth MRR with rolling-median window=3. also cap slice ramp to 5% when slice traffic <1% to avoid noisy signals.

maria: pushed a canary config draft (snippet):

```
warmstart: [1,2,5]
window_hours: 2
stability_windows_required: 2
fallback_rules:
  mrr_down_pct: 1.5
  p95_latency_ms: 150
  hallucination_pct: 0.5
  cooldown_minutes: 60
slice_caps:
  min_slice_traffic_pct: 0.2
  max_slice_ramp_pct: 5
```

canary-bot: smokecheck complete for 5412361111 — long-doc MRR -1.8% (p=0.08), p95 -110ms, p50 -40ms, cost -18%. fallback NOT triggered. flagged: shadow longer + sample increase. link: https://ci.redwood-inference/smoke/5412361111

dain: since fallback not triggered but MRR close, start targeted shadow for 12h at 2% and reduce next ramp from 2%->5% to 2%->2% (hold) until two stable windows. persist eval traces for 1M tokens on that slice.

sophia: add policy: if slice MRR drop >1% but global MRR stable within 0.5%, do not auto-rollback; instead hold + shadow. only global/regional regressions cause hard rollback.

maria: action list: (1) apply revised canary config, (2) start 12h shadow for long-doc slice @2%, (3) collect 1M token traces and run offline eval overnight, (4) add dashboard alert for slice MRR delta >=1% with 30m aggregation. I'll update thread.

raj: add jitter to promotion timing +/-10% to avoid concurrent spikes across regions.

maria: done, thanks. canary-bot: schedule the revised warmstart and shadow run; report in 12h. :robot_face:
